shadows.name: workspace
shadows.purpose: Separate the workspace from the ambient background.

motion.name: hover
motion.purpose: Fine-pointer color feedback only; reduced motion removes it.

narrative.overview: A calm desktop workspace with a bold creative studio character. Translucent chrome surrounds a quiet reading surface.

rules.name: Originals remain readable
rules.body: Keep glass in the chrome and use a nearly opaque reading surface.

dos: Keep focus visible and touch targets at least 44px high.
donts: Do not imply submission or off-device recovery without evidence.
